name: luna-journal
description: Posts a short end-of-session journal to Luna as untrusted episodic memory

luna_url.title: Luna journal URL
luna_url.description: Full URL of Luna's journal route, e.g. http://<luna-host>:4753/v1/journal

luna_token.title: Luna journal token
luna_token.description: LUNA_JOURNAL_TOKEN from the Luna server. Optional: the macOS Keychain item 'luna-journal' or the LUNA_JOURNAL_TOKEN env var also work.

model.title: Summary model
model.description: Model alias used to write the 2-4 line summary

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn journaling off without uninstalling the mod
